source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Locate a decimal or fractional quantity on a ruler or number line by using the size of each equal division.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Endpoint is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Locate a decimal or fractional quantity on a ruler or number line by' is answered as endpoint rather than number line.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Endpoint is what produces number line, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Locate a decimal or fractional quantity on a ruler or.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is number line because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Locate a decimal or fractional quantity on a ruler or number line by' as the operative test.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: number line is settled by running 'Compare or order decimals by place value, not by the number of digits': Compare decimal numbers from the highest place value downward; when the first unequal — on the item about Locate a decimal or fractional quantity on a ruler or.

intelligence.enrichment: To place a decimal on a number line, first choose the interval containing it, then divide that interval into equal parts matching the next place value and count the needed parts from the left endpoint.
